home.faq1_q: How is MFCT different from other fundraising platforms?
home.faq1_a: We operate at 0% platform fee and every case is verified on the ground by the local mohalla committee.
home.faq2_q: Does my donation reach 100% directly to the beneficiary?
home.faq2_a: Yes, emergency medical funds go directly to the hospital and nikah/ration items go directly from vendor to beneficiary.
home.faq3_q: Will I receive an 80G tax exemption receipt?
home.faq3_a: Yes, an official 80G receipt is issued instantly upon entering your PAN number.
home.faq4_q: Can I give my Zakat through these campaigns?
home.faq4_a: Yes, campaigns marked 'Zakat Eligible' are 100% Shariah-compliant and given only to eligible beneficiaries.

about.founders_section_subtitle: Guiding thoughts and resolute principles that form the bedrock of every decision at MFCT
about.zahid_quote: “For me, MFCT is not merely an organization, but a philosophy - an ideal where no family feels alone in their times of distress.”
about.zahid_p1: Inspired by the sacred memory of Late Mohammad Faeem Sahab, we started MFCT to dedicate ourselves to community service. I firmly believe that when people stand together, small collective efforts can become an immense pillar of support for a struggling family.
about.zahid_p2: My dream is that MFCT should not remain limited to one city or district, but reach every single individual who needs community solidarity and support.
about.zahid_callout_label: My message to every member is simple—
about.zahid_callout_quote: “Don't just be a member; be the reason someone finds support in their hardest times.”
about.zahid_p3: Our commitment is that MFCT will always prioritize service, transparency, strict discipline, and mutual cooperation above all else.
about.zahid_p4: We will walk together, grow together, and leave behind a legacy of service that future generations will remember.
about.amreen_quote: “For me, service does not merely mean giving financial aid, but giving someone the reassurance that they are not standing alone.”
about.amreen_p1: My purpose in establishing MFCT is to deepen empathy, mutual solidarity, and the spirit of humanity across our society.
about.amreen_p2: We aspire for MFCT to be a platform where every member feels that they are not just part of an NGO, but part of a caring, united family.
about.amreen_p3: We strive to ensure integrity, accountability, and total transparency in every activity, delivering assistance to beneficiaries with utmost dignity.
about.amreen_p4: I especially appeal to women, youth, and families to join this movement and involve their communities—because a single person's resolve can ignite a transformative movement.
about.amreen_callout_quote: “Let us become someone's support today, so that in times of need tomorrow, society stands with us.”
about.amreen_p5: Come, let us make selfless service our sacred duty and humanity our enduring identity.
